title: Overgeared
description: Shin Youngwoo, also known by his in-game name Grid, is an unlucky low-level player in the popular virtual reality game Satisfy. His life changes when he discovers a legendary item and obtains the rare class title of Pagma's Successor. With the ability to create powerful equipment and legendary weapons, Grid gradually transforms from an unfortunate player into one of the strongest figures in Satisfy.
author: LEE Dong Wook / PARK Saenal
